news.title: KSU student had been dead for days in dorm; roommates didn’t notice
news.summary: A Kennesaw State University student was found dead in his dorm room after his mother called in a welfare check. She had not heard from him in about 10 days.

news.title: Viral TikTok trend leads to 5 arrests in Gwinnett County
news.summary: Five adults were arrested, and seven teens were contacted after breaking into an unoccupied home in the 3900 block of Westbrook Road in Suwanee, according to the Gwinnett County Police Department.

news.title: 2 dead, 6 injured in downtown Minneapolis shooting
news.summary: Police said the gunman was also dead. It's unclear how he died.

news.title: Clayton County deputy arrested, charged with misusing Flock Safety license plate reader
news.summary: According to authorities, the deputy, 40-year-old Errol Farrell Jr., used the Flock Safety system for non-law-enforcement purposes.

news.title: Police investigating homicide on Centennial Olympic Park Dr.
news.summary: This is now the second homicide today in the City of Atlanta.
